content: चमसः, -सम् [चमत्यस्मिन्, चम्-असच् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A vessel (can, ladle <ab>&c.</ab>) used at sacrifices for drinking the Soma juice; <ls>Y. 1. 183</ls> (also चमंसी); इडोदरे चमसाः कर्णरन्ध्रे <ls>Bhāg. 3. 13. 36</ls>. .²2 A cake made of barley, rice <ab>&c.</ab>
